sloka: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहू रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।सन्धाय बाणमस्त्रेण चमूपतिमताडयत् ।। ६.५९.८९ ।।।।
transliteration: evamuktvā mahābāhū rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।sandhāya bāṇamastreṇa camūpatimatāḍayat ।। 6.59.89 ।।।।

translations.english: "The arrow released by me now is charged with a missile and will destroy your life. You have been protecting (changing your forms) your life."
